title: 第五章 凝练内劲第六章 克扣赏赐
content_zh:
“这是内劲？”
一个健步从床上跃下，周身肌肉一振，感觉力量要比以往强大许多，足足增加了上百斤。
毫无疑问，自己已进入一个新的世界，展现出来一片新的天地。
“真的是内劲？我一觉醒……开辟出武脉，就凝练了内劲？”
这一刹那，叶枫彻底变得狂喜，兴奋无比。
这个世界，觉醒武脉还不能称之为武者，唯有练出内劲，才算踏入了武士境第一重。
武士境只是整个武道修炼系统中最最低级的境界，分为一到七重。
第一重就是觉醒武脉后，丹田凝练出内劲，力量增加百斤，简单踏出修武的第一步，能否做到这一点是武者和普通人最大的区别，元武大陆武运昌隆，觉醒三条以下武脉的人占了十之八九，而一般这样的人，从觉醒到凝练内劲差不多需要半年时间。
到了第二重牛劲，力量可达三百斤，拥有了一牛之力，防御也随之变得强悍。
第三重虎力，力量倍增，达到五百斤，一般觉醒武脉在三条左右的黄阶天赋武者，三十岁前差不多就能走到这一步。
第四重之后的换血、化气、炼气等境界，可让肉身变得更加强大，尤其是第五重化气之后，丹田内劲转化为真气，真气外放，使得杀伤力大幅提升，一旦全力出手，可以搏杀百人，是名副其实的百人斩。
至于炼气之上的先天境，能够引动天地之力，跟武士境最大的差别就是元力，将真气修炼到大圆满之后孕育出元力，即为先天。
先天武师，精神沟通天地、肉身横行虚空，无论精神和肉身都完全变成了两个概念，元武大陆有一句话：一入先天便成神。
虽然说的有些夸张，可也能从这句留传数万年的古言中，大致推测出先天武师的强大。
先天武师，万中无一，整个巴立城也唯有寥寥数人而已。
但现在，叶枫虽然只拥有一条武脉，可这条开辟出来的武脉和寻常觉醒的武脉并不一样，凸显出了它神秘和强大的地方，居然使叶枫在短短一小时都不到的时间，丹田凝出内劲？
这怎么能不让他欣喜若狂？
真如元灵所言，“万古长青脉”
，确实有牛逼哄哄之处。
叶枫仔细感悟着，丹田中的金黄种子犹如不知疲倦的机器，随着自己的呼吸而鼓动，将吸纳得来的血气转化成内劲，当然因为叶枫还没有修炼功法的缘故，所得内劲不是很多，不过武士一重的丹田气海只有鸡蛋那么点大，这么一会功夫，内劲已经积下了十分之一左右。

照此估计，达到充盈地步用不了多久。
自动凝练内劲，速度居然还如此迅速，恐怕那些被称为天才的七八脉武者，都要自叹不如了吧。
此时此刻，叶枫再也按捺不住，爽朗的大笑起来……
笑声让一边的花菱眼中露出惊疑神色。
在叶枫跳下木床那一刻起，她的注意力就牢牢牵挂在了叶枫身上。
“哥哥。
你，你真的觉醒了武脉？”
以一种不可置信的眼神盯着大笑的哥哥，花菱觉得很不可思议。
当年养父叶天还在的时候，哥哥就被判定为修武废材，无法觉醒武脉，怎么今天睡着睡着突然就觉醒了呢？
content_en:
"Is this inner strength?"
He jumped off the bed with a quick stride, and his muscles all over his body shook. He felt that his strength was much stronger than before, and he had gained hundreds of kilograms.
There is no doubt that I have entered a new world and a new world has emerged.
"Is it really inner energy? As soon as I awakened... and opened up my martial veins, I condensed my inner energy?"
At this moment, Ye Feng became completely ecstatic and extremely excited.
In this world, those who have awakened their martial veins cannot yet be called warriors. Only by cultivating their inner strength can they step into the first level of the warrior realm.
The warrior realm is only the lowest realm in the entire martial arts training system, divided into levels one to seven.
The first level is after awakening the martial arts, the inner energy is condensed in the Dantian, the strength is increased by a hundred kilograms, and the first step of martial arts training is simply taken. Whether a warrior can do this is the biggest difference between a warrior and an ordinary person. The Yuanwu Continent has a prosperous martial arts fortune, and nine out of ten people have awakened three or less martial arts veins. For such people, it usually takes about half a year from awakening to condensing the inner energy.
At the second level of Niu Jin, the strength can reach 300 kilograms. With the strength of an ox, the defense also becomes stronger.
The third level of tiger power doubles the strength to 500 kilograms. Generally, a yellow-level talented warrior who has awakened around three martial arts veins can reach this point before the age of thirty.
The realms of blood exchange, qi transformation, and qi refining after the fourth level can make the physical body more powerful. Especially after the fifth level of qi transformation, the inner energy of the Dantian is transformed into true energy, and the true energy is released outward, which greatly increases the lethality. Once used with all one's strength, one can kill hundreds of people, which is a veritable 100-man slayer.
As for the Xiantian realm above Qi refining, it can activate the power of heaven and earth. The biggest difference from the warrior realm is Yuanli. After cultivating Qi to the Great Perfection, Yuanli is born, which is Xiantian.
Innate martial masters, their spirit communicates with heaven and earth, and their body travels across the void. Both their spirit and body have completely become two concepts. There is a saying in Yuanwu Continent: Once you enter the innate world, you will become a god.
Although it is a bit exaggerated, one can roughly infer the power of the innate martial artist from this ancient saying that has been passed down for tens of thousands of years.
There is only one innate martial artist among ten thousand, and there are only a handful of them in the entire city of Bali.
But now, although Ye Feng only has one martial vein, this opened martial vein is different from the ordinary awakened martial vein, highlighting its mystery and power. It actually allows Ye Feng to condense internal energy in his Dantian in less than an hour?
How could this not make him ecstatic?
As Yuan Ling said, "Eternally Green Veins"
, there is indeed something awesome about it.
Ye Feng carefully realized that the golden seeds in his Dantian were like tireless machines, instigating with his breathing, converting the absorbed blood into internal energy. Of course, because Ye Feng had not practiced the technique yet, the internal energy gained was not very much, but the Qi sea in Dantian of the first level warrior was only a little bit as big as an egg. After a while, about one-tenth of the internal energy had been accumulated.
Based on this estimate, it won't take long to reach fullness.
The speed of automatically condensing inner strength is so fast, I am afraid those warriors of the seventh and eighth veins who are called geniuses will feel inferior to themselves.
At this moment, Ye Feng could no longer hold back and laughed heartily...
The laughter made Hua Ling on one side look suspicious in his eyes.
From the moment Ye Feng jumped off the wooden bed, her attention was firmly focused on Ye Feng.
"Brother.
You, have you really awakened your martial arts? "
Staring at his laughing brother with disbelief, Hana Ling found it incredible.
When his adoptive father Ye Tian was still alive, his brother was judged to be a waste of martial arts and could not awaken his martial arts. Why did he suddenly awaken while sleeping today?
